about: Test-only proxy bytes (#1092). Each file is a public archive copy of an answer-key page that FAILS the source-bytes same-document test, so it is not in the source-bytes replay, its manifest or its denominator. A proxy test reads one to check a reader change against the page's own markup; it never scores recall against the answer key's amounts as if the page were the keyed document.

proxies.institution: St. Cloud Financial Federal Credit Union
proxies.fetchedWith: curl -s -L (plain HTTP, the archive's raw id_ form; no Wayback toolbar)
